name: SikaShield P44 T Fidia 4 mm
paste:
SIKASHIELD® P44 T FIDIA 4 MM: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaShield® P44 T Fidia 4 mm, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikashield-p44-tfidia4mm.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaShield® P44 T Fidia 4 mm where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaShield® P44 T Fidia 4 mm is an APP modified bituminous waterproofing membrane with a thickness of 4 mm. It is reinforced with a non-woven polyester fabric dimensionally stabilised with glass fibre and is flexible at -10 °C. The top surface is coated with talc, which ensures the bond of the overlying layer and fast welding of the joints. The underside of the product has a burn-off film for easy torch-application.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. The Product is used as a waterproofing membrane for:
    - Balconies and terraces under a heavy protection layer such as tiles or gravel.
    - Flat and sloping roofs under protective layers or ballast
    - Wet areas
    - Basements and other below ground structures
    - Horizontal reinforced concrete slabs, decks, podiums and protrusions
    - Vertical reinforced concrete walls
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - The Product is used as a.
    - Base sheet in multi-layer systems
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - The Product is not suitable for roofs permanently exposed to UV radiation.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaShield® P44 T Fidia 4 mm
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Plastomeric bituminous membrane surfaced with talc and flexible at -10 °C (Formerly Index Fidia 4mm)
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 13707:2004+A2:2009 Flexible sheets for waterproofing — Reinforced bitumen sheets for roof waterproofing — Definitions and characteristics
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 13969:2004/A1:2006 Flexible sheets for waterproofing — Bitumen damp proof sheets including bitumen basement tanking sheets — Definitions and characteristics
    - AS4654.1- 2012- Approved for external above ground use (Test certificate available upon request)
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13707:2004+A2: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 13969:2004: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS4654.1- 2012: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1848-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Packaging (p.1).
    - EN 1849-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Effective thickness (p.2).
    - EN 12311-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation at maximum tensile force (p.2); Technical Information > Maximum tensile force (p.2).
    - EN 12310-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to tear (p.2).
    - EN 12317-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Joint shear resistance (p.2).
    - EN 1109: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexibility at low temperature (p.2).
    - EN 1110: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flow resistance (p.2).
    - EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
    - EN 13501-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to install by torching method
    - Fully bonded
    - Good mechanical properties (tensile, tear, shear)
    - Fast and easy installation

2.15 Storage conditions. The Product must be stored in original unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions and temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Store in a vertical position. Do not stack pallets of the rolls on top of each other, or under pallets of any other materials during transport or storage. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate condition. The substrate surface must be uniform, firm, smooth and free of any sharp protrusion or burrs, clean, dry, free of grease, laitance, oil, dust and loosely adhering particles.
3.3 Priming. Apply Sika® Igolflex P-10+ primer at a rate of 6-8m2 per litre.Note: Consumption rates will vary depending onsubstrate type and porosity.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Effective thickness.
    | Effective thickness | 4.0 mm ± 0.2 mm |
    Test method printed: (EN 1849-1)
4.3 System design. Consider the following when designing the roof system:
    - The supporting structure must be of sufficient structural strength to support all new and existing layers of the roof build-up.
    - The complete roof system must be designed to withstand and be secured against wind uplift loadings.
    - The wind uplift resistance of the adhered roofing assembly is limited by the adhesion strength of the Product to the substrate.
4.4 Important.
    - At low temperatures, take care unrolling toavoid damaging the membrane.
    - Use suitable footwear to avoid puncturing the membrane.
    - Do not apply to wet, damp or unclean surfaces
    - Do not over-torch the membrane otherwise the polyester reinforcement (which melts at 260 °C) will be damaged making the membrane un-useable.
    - If membrane is insufficiently heated, this can cause reduced adhesion to the substrate, between layers or on the overlaps. If this occurs, un-bonded areas must be lifted and re-torched.
    - If a seasonal symbol is printed on the roll’s label, it is advisable to use the membrane during the indicated season.
4.5 Alignment. Unroll, align and re-roll correctly before torching.
4.6 Overlaps. Side: 100mm. End: 150 mm.
4.7 Fastening. Fidia Polyester when used as a roofing base sheet, can be mechanically fixed on the substrate by using the correct type of fasteners. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
4.8 Torching.
    - Use a gas burner to heat the substrate and the backing film on the underside of membrane. When the backing film starts to melt, the membrane is ready to stick. Roll the membrane forward and press firmly against the substrate to bond. Ensure a bead of melted bitumen is visible along the full length of the overlap sides DETAILING
    - All details such as internal and external corners, upstands, vent pipes, drains, support metalwork etc. must be cut and sealed effectively. Detailing must follow the recommended guidelines and good practice for torch-applied membranes.
4.9 Further information.
    - Guidelines and good practice for torch-applied membranes
    - Method Statement - Roofing Build-up with Bituminous Membranes
    - Method Statement - Bituminous membranes for below ground

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature.
    | Minimum | +5 °C |
    | Maximum | +40 °C |
5.3 Relative air humidity.
    | Maximum | 80 % |
5.4 Substrate temperature.
    | Minimum | +5 °C |
    | Maximum | +40 °C |
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Packaging: Roll width | 1.0 m; Roll length | 10.0 m; Refer to current price list for packaging variations. (EN 1848-1)
    - Effective thickness: Effective thickness | 4.0 mm ± 0.2 mm (EN 1849-1)
    - Maximum tensile force: Longitudinal (MD) | 450 N/50 mm ± 90 N/50; mm; Transversal (CMD) | 400 N/50 mm ± 80 N/50; mm (EN 12311-1)
    - Elongation at maximum tensile force: Longitudinal (MD) | 40 % ± 15 %; Transversal (CMD) | 40 % ± 15 % (EN 12311-1)
    - Resistance to tear: Longitudinal (MD) | 150 N ± 45 N; Transversal (CMD) | 150 N ± 45 N (EN 12310-1)
    - Joint shear resistance: Longitudinal | 350 N/50 mm ± 70 N/50; mm; Transversal | 300 N/50 mm ± 60 N/50; mm (EN 12317-1)
    - Flexibility at low temperature: ≤ -10 °C (EN 1109)
    - Flow resistance: 100 °C–10 °C (EN 1110)
    - Watertightness: Method B: 24 hours at 60 | Pass; kPa (EN 1928)
    - Reaction to fire: Class E (EN 13501-1)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaShield® P44 T Fidia 4 mm, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikashield-p44-tfidia4mm.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Maintenance.
    - Check the functionality of the auxiliary works, flashings, drainage outlets, overflow pipes etc.
    - Remove any leaves, moss and other vegetation, which could cause ponding on the roof and overload the drainage system.
    - To maintain the function of the roof waterproofing membrane during its lifespan, it is advisable to arrange periodically for inspection of the membrane and detailing.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
